items.docs: Validates a provided API Key and returns profile and provisioning information associated with it.

Request details of one or more channels such as available datetime ranges, download filetype, and the size of data available. Channel data is always in motion so the details represent a moving window of data available for download.

Download data associated with a given channel. The seconds portion of start/end times are ignored, but for API consistency, seconds must be given. If no data is available then an HTTP 404 is returned.

Generate a presigned URL to download data associated with a channel
later or independently of the SIE Batch webserver. Generated URLs
are shareable and do not reveal credentials. The seconds portion of
start/end times are ignored.

The requested `start_time`/`end_time` must fall within the
channel's data retention window. Use `chdetails` to check the
`earliest` and `latest` timestamps before generating a URL.
The `makeurl` call itself succeeds even if the requested range
extends beyond available
